parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path. The type-alias-object 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' in that file is almost certainly a local copy introduced to support the sample app's debug HUD without taking a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. The duplication is therefore structural but intentional: the sample app mirror rule applies. No refactor is warranted.
